answer: Each agent bonds stake to a Semaphore membership commitment and derives an epoch-scoped RLN nullifier from its secret. Messages include zero-knowledge proofs of the required polynomial evaluations. Reusing a nullifier for distinct messages exposes Shamir shares that can reconstruct the private key, allowing validators to slash the bond immediately. “Shale,” “forge,” and “opal” are illustrative labels only; they add no security assumptions.
